title: A Komodo Dragon Can Swallow 80% of Its Body Weight in One Meal

scenes.text: A Komodo dragon can eat eighty percent of its own weight in one meal.
A typical wild dragon weighs about 154 pounds.
So that is a 123-pound dinner. In one sitting.
The biggest verified one was over ten feet long and weighed 366 pounds.
Old stories of enormous captured dragons? Probably weighed right after a meal.
Eighty percent of its body. In one meal.

description:
A Komodo dragon can eat up to 80 percent of its own body weight in a single meal.
A typical wild adult weighs around 154 pounds, so a full meal can be well over 120 pounds. The largest verified dragon was 10.3 feet long and 366 pounds.
What is the most you have ever eaten at once? Tell us below.
